source: marco-investigation (note 89 ; rédaction, micro, rotative, sections notées 4-5), castelactu (rotative, papier journal, micro, caméra, mains au téléphone ; v2 du 2 novembre), surffm (note 90 ; radio sur le sable, platines, sections notées 4-5), coupdefood (sommaire, kit presse, notés 4-5).
style: Modern editorial documentary photograph, full-frame camera, 35mm lens, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, calm and credible, clean composition with generous negative space.
interdits: No readable headline, no newspaper title, no readable print, no screen content, no on-air sign with letters, no real journalist, no real place presented as news, no logo on microphones.
evite: Évite d'illustrer une vraie actualité ou un lieu réel avec une image générée : la presse, le studio et le papier en ambiance, le texte toujours flou ou vierge.

404.consigne: A folded newspaper with blank, unreadable columns lying on a small café table next to a cup of coffee, morning side light through a window, soft shadows, cosy and quiet.

ouverture.consigne: Close-up of {sujet} in full motion: a wide ribbon of blank paper racing over polished steel rollers and black ink rollers, strong motion blur on the paper, crisp metal details in the foreground, dark hall behind, no readable print.

section-fond.consigne: Flat top-down macro texture of blank off-white newsprint, visible fibres, very faint scattered halftone dots and a soft fold line, perfectly even diffuse lighting, no shadows, seamless and calm.

scene-metier.consigne: Three-quarter overhead view of a small independent newsroom desk at the end of the day: {sujet}, an open reporter's notebook with blank pages, a fountain pen, folded newspapers with blurred unreadable columns, warm lamp light.

lieu.consigne: A professional microphone on a boom arm in a small warm studio, acoustic panels softly out of focus, closed-back headphones resting on the table, warm lamp glow, an on-air light out of focus with no letters, nobody.
lieu.evite: Le studio présenté comme celui de la radio.

texture.consigne: Motion-blurred close-up of a paper web running fast over steel rollers, glistening ink rollers, warm light, strong sense of speed and energy, no readable print.

portrait-generique.consigne: Two hands holding a smartphone upright and filming, seen over the shoulder at hand level only, the screen showing a blurred evening street with warm bokeh, the hands lit by the screen glow, no face, no brand.
